title: iPSC Karyotyping Protocol
author: Yu Chen
materials: 24 hours after seeding. iPSCs were treated with Colcemid (1:100, Roche, 10295892001) for 12 hours.

steps.title: Dissociate and plate iPSCs
steps.instruction: Dissociate iPSCs using Accutase and plate them in 6 well plates.

substeps.instruction: Plate cells at a density of 1x106 cells/well.
Use StemFlex medium supplemented with 10 μM Y-27632.

steps.title: Transfer cells for karyotyping
steps.instruction: Transfer the treated iPSCs to the NHGRI Cytogenetics Core for karyotyping analysis.
